name: Get Program Members
summary: Lists the members of a program, filterable by status, lead ID, or any program member field. Supports paging.
whenToUse: When you want to see who's in a program and at what status — or export that audience.

query.name: filterType
query.label: Filter on
query.hint: What to filter by: leadId, statusName, reachedSuccess, or one of the program's custom fields.

query.name: filterValues
query.label: Filter value(s)
query.hint: Comma-separated values. Max 300. E.g. the status name (Member, Influenced, …) or lead IDs.

query.name: fields
query.label: Fields to return
query.hint: Optional comma-separated field API names to include. See 'Get Program Member Fields' for the list.

query.name: nextPageToken
query.label: Next page token
query.hint: Optional. Copy nextPageToken from the previous response to get the next page.

response.description: Program member records (leadId, statusName, membershipDate, custom fields, …).

notes: Programs with more than 100,000 members can't be queried this way (error 1003) — use a Bulk Program Member Extract (Phase 4) instead.
Status names are per-program (defined by the program's channel) — e.g. Member, Influenced, Completed.
